name: com.mathorio/mathorio
title: Mathorio
description: Math lessons with clear examples and a daily math challenge, from first steps to algebra.

tools.name: find_math_lesson
tools.description: Find a lesson on Mathorio, a free math site (arithmetic, fractions, decimals, percentages, algebra, geometry, statistics, probability, trigonometry, pre-calculus). Returns the definition and key points in plain English and a link to the full lesson with worked step-by-step examples, common mistakes and practice problems with instant feedback, a printable worksheet with answer key and a teacher guide. No account needed.

topic.description: Math topic or question, e.g. "order of operations", "adding fractions", "pythagorean theorem"

tools.name: daily_math_challenge
tools.description: Mathorio's Daily Math Challenge: one new problem every day, the same for everyone, three tries and a streak. Returns today's problem (without the answer) and the link to solve it. Use for a class warm up or a daily brain teaser.
